flags.message: record/same-question.json has cutoff 2026-11-03, one day after both the 2026-11-02 snapshot date and this cell's current date. Its petitions list is empty, and no substantive inference or forecast adjustment was drawn from the index. This is a metadata consistency note, not outcome leakage or a blocker.

Snapshot shows 14 cert-stage amicus briefs (several marked VIDED), yet context.json has amicus_briefs: null and vide_links: [], and no related docket was staged. The forecast used the snapshot's count.

Snapshot 2026-10-17.json has DocketedDate October 28, 2026, later than its snapshot/context date and the October 16 opening submission. This is inconsistent header chronology, not observed disposition leakage. Forecast uses the authoritative arrival event and sole frozen submission entry, does not treat the later header date as a procedural signal, and retains uncertainty about timing. No target-case outcome or later proceedings were retrieved.

Provisioned record/documents/application.txt has empty_text: true (ocr_derived: false, 12 pages) because the upstream PDF (20261028134604134_scan_kratliff_2026-10-28-13-25-11.pdf) is a scanned filing without an embedded text layer. Forecast relied on the Supreme Court snapshot (2026-10-21.json) and lower-court RECAP docket entries for S.D. Fla. No. 1:26-cv-25796.

The application manifest reports a 12-page filing with empty_text=true and ocr_derived=false; application.txt contains only blank lines. The filing is present, not absent, but the legal grounds, precise relief, threatened injury, and underlying orders cannot be assessed. Forecast completed from the arrival snapshot and strictly prior interim counts; stakes score left null with rationale.

Snapshot 2026-10-21.json retains DocketedDate October 28, 2026 although its only proceeding is submission on October 20 and context freezes an October 21 arrival-position boundary. Event opened_at is October 20. This appears to be later docket metadata retained with truncated proceedings. I used the declared event and frozen procedural state, not the later docketing date as escalation evidence; no outcome material surfaced.
application.txt (12-page scan) provisioned with empty_text: true and no OCR; the requested relief and grounds were inferred from the docket caption only.
